landing.heroTitle: Iibi wax kasta. Lacag hel. Hal xiriiriye.
landing.heroSubtitle: Ganacsigaaga oo dhan hal xiriiriye — koorsooyin, tababar, faylal, alaabo iyo wax kale. Loo dhisay abuurayaasha Itoobiya.
landing.step1Body: Iska diiwaangeli iimaylkaaga oo keliya — furaha sirta looma baahna.
landing.step2Body: Faylal, koorsooyin, tababar, alaabo — toban dariiqo dakhli.
landing.step3Body: Hal xiriiriye oo ku yaal bio-ga TikTok waa dukaankaaga oo dhan.
landing.step4Body: La soco dakhligaaga oo codso lacag-bixin goor kasta.
